_note: judge 评测的 ground truth。expected_judgment 取值 consistent / scope_mismatch / topic_mismatch，对应 CI 里的 无 / WARNING / ERROR。来自 Marble os-taxonomy 的案例其描述是**忠实重述而非逐字原文**（其内容许可为 CC BY-SA 4.0，此处不做再分发）。前 3 条 topic_mismatch 是最初手工核对出来的；其余 Marble 案例来自 2026-07-26 对 124 个真实节点的抽样跑，是判定标准从二值扩到三值的直接原因。

cases.name: Arrays for multiplication
cases.description: Divide a four-digit number by a one-digit number using the short division algorithm.
cases.note: 名说乘法阵列，描述在讲短除法 —— 乘法 vs 除法，不同知识点

cases.name: Understanding angles
cases.description: Find the area of a rectangle by multiplying its side lengths.
cases.note: 名说认识角，描述在求长方形面积

cases.name: Understanding angles
cases.description: Classify quadrilaterals such as squares, rectangles, and parallelograms by their properties.
cases.note: 名说认识角，描述在做四边形分类

cases.name: Decimal place value
cases.description: Convert between standard measurement units of length, mass, volume and time within one system, writing the results in decimal notation.
cases.note: 名说小数位值，描述教的技能是计量单位换算 —— 用到小数不等于在教小数位值

cases.name: Deep-Sea Survival
cases.description: Explain how deep-sea animals cope with crushing pressure; also cover antifreeze proteins in Antarctic fish, supercooling in wood frogs, cryptobiosis in tardigrades, and other extremophiles such as thermophiles and halophiles.
cases.note: 同属极端环境生存主题，但描述远超『深海』所圈定的范围

cases.name: Earthquake-Resistant Design
cases.description: Know that buildings can be designed to resist earthquakes, that tsunami warning systems alert coastal communities, and that communities prepare with evacuation plans and drills.
cases.note: 名称只讲建筑抗震设计，描述还含海啸预警与社区疏散演练

cases.name: Volcanoes & Mass Extinctions
cases.description: Explain how large igneous provinces drove global warming, ocean acidification and mass extinctions; also explore how hydrothermal vents on the early Earth may have been the cradle of life.
cases.note: 主体切题，但描述延伸到了生命起源，超出『火山与大灭绝』

cases.name: Crime & Punishment
cases.description: How justice worked in medieval times: trial by ordeal, trial by combat, the role of the sheriff, and punishments such as the stocks and pillory.
cases.note: 反方向的范围不匹配：名称是宽泛标题，描述特指中世纪司法

cases.name: Roman numerals to 100
cases.description: Read Roman numerals from I to C, and understand that numeral systems changed over time to include zero and place value.
cases.note: 描述前半切题，后半延伸到记数系统的演变，超出名称

cases.name: Telling time to the minute
cases.description: Tell and write the time from analogue and digital clocks to the nearest five minutes, using a.m./p.m. and 12- and 24-hour notation.
cases.note: 粒度对不上：名称说精确到分，描述只要求到五分钟

cases.name: Testing Push & Pull Designs
cases.description: Analyse data to determine whether a design solution works as intended to change the speed or direction of an object with a push or a pull.
cases.note: 对抗样本：初版提示词把这条误判为不符，但『分析数据检验推拉设计是否奏效』正是名称说的事

cases.name: Understanding angles
cases.description: Recognize that an angle is formed by two rays sharing a common endpoint, and identify acute, right, and obtuse angles.
cases.note: 名实相符的『认识角』对照组

cases.name: Adding fractions with like denominators
cases.description: Add two fractions that share the same denominator by adding the numerators and keeping the denominator.

cases.name: 三角形内角和
cases.description: 三角形三个内角的度数之和等于 180 度。

cases.name: 平均数 (mean)
cases.description: The mean of a data set is the sum of all the values divided by the number of values.
cases.note: 中英混排、跨语言一致案例

cases.name: Reading bar graphs
cases.description: Read and compare the values represented by the bars in a bar graph.
